items.quote: So they got up and fled in the dusk and abandoned their tents and their horses and donkeys.
items.contrast: The Arameans, rather than the people who approached their camp, fled and left it behind.
items.reason: The pronoun “they” in verse 7 refers back to the Arameans in verse 6. Readers must track the change between the people approaching the camp and its occupants fleeing from it.
